description: Change what someone may do in this workspace. Owners and admins can manage forms, responses, integrations, and credentials; members cannot. This changes who has authority over everything in here, so pass confirm=true when the user authorized this action on the specified target. Otherwise ask for their decision. You can never grant a role above the acting person's own. Identify the member by id or email from fillo_list_members. Needs members:manage.

confirm.description: Set true when the user has authorized this action on the specified target in the task or workflow. Ask only if that authorization is missing.

member.description: Member id or email from fillo_list_members.

name: fillo_change_member_role
title: Change a member's role
